definitions.explanation: A person who has written a book or other written work.

examples.japanese: {著者|ちょしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}いたい→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I want to meet the author.

examples.japanese: {著者|ちょしゃ}⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{著者|ちょしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{科学者|かがくしゃ}→科学者：19378_kagakusha⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The author of this book is a famous scientist.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {著者|ちょしゃ}: Author (of books, academic works)
- ⟦{作者|さくしゃ}→作者：04169_sakusha⟧: Author, creator (of literary works, manga, plays)
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: Writer, novelist (professional title)
- ⟦{筆者|ひっしゃ}→筆者：04348_hissha⟧: Writer (of the text you're reading, often essays/articles)

USAGE:
{著者|ちょしゃ} is commonly used in academic or formal contexts, while ⟦{作者|さくしゃ}→作者：04169_sakusha⟧ is broader and includes creative works.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {著者|ちょしゃ}⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧ (author introduction/bio)
- {著者|ちょしゃ}⟦{名|めい}→名：noentry⟧ (author's name)
